name: Springfield Boys & Girls Club Summer Program
description_short: A summer day program at the Springfield Boys and Girls Club on Carew Street, with sports, STEM, arts and games built around weekly themes. In 2026 it ran June 29 to August 21, 8:00 am to 5:30 pm.
